pages.text: Workers mine ores and valuable blocks and carry them home. Blue mineral crystals hold 500 each, 5 a trip; a crystal stands on mineralized earth and cannot be broken — your hand takes a shard.
Vespene is a slow green liquid rising in veins from bedrock. A gas building goes on an outlet; a canister of iron and glass carries it.

Supply comes from overlords, supply depots and pylons. Prices, build times and supply follow StarCraft II. A worker with nothing in reach explores farther, on the land and under it; a worker in danger gets an escort, and a dark place is lit its race's way.
